Package dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk

Class PerkDefinition

java.lang.Object
dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.PerkDefinition
public final class PerkDefinition extends Object
Describes a perk: its key, the kind of value it holds, its server-wide default and bounds, and how menus show it.

Every built-in Perk has a definition, and addons register their own with PerkService.registerPerk(org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin, dev.itsharshxd.zentrix.api.perk.PerkDefinition). Both resolve through the same path: tiers in perks.yml set a value under the perk's key, boosts add to it, and /perks, the tier editor and placeholders show it. 


 PerkDefinition kits = PerkDefinition.number("myaddon.kit-slots")
         .defaultValue(1).minimum(0).unlimited(true)
         .displayName("&bKit Slots").icon(Material.CHEST)
         .description("How many kits a player may save.")
         .build();
 ZentrixAPI.get().getPerkService().registerPerk(plugin, kits);

Two definitions are equal when their keys are.

Since:
1.16.0
